purpose: Measure whether the repaired v0.4 output contract removes the phrasing-dependent verdict instability observed in v0.3, where one frozen candidate, fixture and grader produced different behavioral results across runs.
pass_rule: Every fixture must PASS on every one of its 3 independent trials, on every executed model family. Any single trial failure ends this gate as FAIL. Best-of-N is not a pass. A rerun after a professional failure is not permitted without a new candidate version and a new freeze.

excluded_model_families.reason: Excluded by explicit evaluator instruction for this cycle; no OpenAI quota may be consumed.
No automated executor or credential path exists in this repository.

grader_change_policy: The grader blob above is fixed for this gate. It must not be broadened, narrowed or otherwise edited after any candidate output is observed. If a construct defect is discovered, the affected case is burned in a recorded burn entry and requires a fresh case, exactly as q10-invalidation-and-q11-preregistration-v0.2.json did.
what_this_gate_does_not_establish: This is NOT a release qualification and cannot admit any core version to the library.

The grader expectations were authored by the party performing the repair, so under the harness's own development-vs-qualification separation these are development/regression evidence, not held-out qualification evidence.
Two of the four historically required model families are not executed in this cycle.

A stable PASS here establishes only that the repaired contract grades one decision consistently; fresh independent held-out qualification by a party outside this repair remains required before any qualified claim.
